name: Vaseline Lip Therapy Cocoa Butter 20g
description:
Product details of Vaseline Lip Therapy Cocoa Butter – 20g

Product Type: Lip Balm / Lip Therapy

Size: 20g

Origin: Made in Poland

Key Features:

Petroleum Jelly & Cocoa Butter: Instantly softens and soothes dry lips

Repairs Lip Barrier: Helps heal and restore lips, not just coat them

Triple-Purified Jelly: Clinically proven formula for effective lip care

Protects & Moisturizes: Locks in moisture to keep lips healthy, soft, and smooth

Packaging: Comes in a steel tin inspired by the original classic look
